body.name: Khat_i
body.def: For \(i\in\{0,1\}\), the empirical Krylov matrix is \(\widehat K_i=[\widehat d_i,\widehat M_i\widehat d_i,\ldots,\widehat M_i^{p-1}\widehat d_i]\), where \(\widehat d_i=\widehat m_{i+1}-\widehat m_i\), \(\widehat M_i=(\widehat C_{i+1}-\widehat C_{i+2})(\widehat C_i-\widehat C_{i+1})^{-1}\), and \(\widehat m_k,\widehat C_k\) are the coordinates of \(\widehat z\).
